import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import scipy.stats as stats

def task_func(x, y, labels):
    def _to_series(obj):
        if isinstance(obj, np.ndarray):
            if obj.ndim <= 1 and obj.dtype != object:
                return [obj]
            return [np.asarray(v) for v in obj]
        if isinstance(obj, (list, tuple)):
            if len(obj) > 0 and hasattr(obj[0], "__len__") and not np.isscalar(obj[0]):
                return [np.asarray(v) for v in obj]
            return [np.asarray(obj)]
        return [np.asarray(obj)]

    x_series = _to_series(x)
    y_series = _to_series(y)

    if isinstance(labels, (list, tuple, np.ndarray)):
        label_list = list(labels)
    else:
        label_list = [labels]

    n = min(len(x_series), len(y_series), len(label_list))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))

    if n == 0:
        ax.set_xlabel("x")
        ax.set_ylabel("y")
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
        return fig

    cmap = plt.get_cmap("tab10")

    for i in range(n):
        xi = np.asarray(x_series[i], dtype=float).ravel()
        yi = np.asarray(y_series[i], dtype=float).ravel()

        m = min(xi.size, yi.size)
        if m == 0:
            continue

        xi = xi[:m]
        yi = yi[:m]

        mask = np.isfinite(xi) & np.isfinite(yi)
        xi = xi[mask]
        yi = yi[mask]

        if xi.size == 0:
            continue

        order = np.argsort(xi)
        xi = xi[order]
        yi = yi[order]

        color = cmap(i % 10)
        ax.plot(xi, yi, label=str(label_list[i]), color=color, linewidth=2)

        if np.all(yi >= 0):
            ax.fill_between(xi, yi, color=color, alpha=0.15)

    ax.set_xlabel("x")
    ax.set_ylabel("y")
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    ax.legend(frameon=False)
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig
